title: how to use specifying model in slash commands and agents?
body:
I found the following change log in the early release notes:

Version 1.0.57:
     • Added support for specifying a model in slash commands

Version 1.0.64:
Agents: Added model customization support - you can now specify which model an agent should use

How to use that? Is there any documentation or example to help us use it?
author: SamPeng87
